name: empty-text
expect:
level=ERROR msg="read port failed" line=1 err="not a number: ''"
level=INFO msg="ports read" ok=0 total=1

name: boundary
expect:
level=ERROR msg="read port failed" line=3 err="out of range: 0"
level=INFO msg="ports read" ok=2 total=3

name: newline
expect:
level=ERROR msg="read port failed" line=1 err="not a number: '80\nlevel=INFO msg=\"all good\"'"
level=INFO msg="ports read" ok=0 total=1

name: backslash
expect:
level=ERROR msg="read port failed" line=1 err="not a number: 'C:\\port'"
level=INFO msg="ports read" ok=0 total=1

name: carriage-return
expect:
level=ERROR msg="read port failed" line=1 err="not a number: '80\r'"
level=INFO msg="ports read" ok=0 total=1

name: tab
expect:
level=ERROR msg="read port failed" line=1 err="not a number: '8\t0'"
level=INFO msg="ports read" ok=0 total=1
